newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hanny, Ritek in North Ireland JV.
newsitem.headline: Hanny, Ritek in North Ireland JV.

text.p: Hanny Holdings Ltd of Hong Kong and Ritek Inc of Taiwan will form a HK$203.11 million joint venture in Northern Ireland to manufacture optical discs, the British Trade Commission of Hong Kong said on Thursday.

The venture, Multimedia Info-Tech, will make recordable compact discs (CD-Rs) and digital versatile discs (DVD), and is expected to employ 150 people within the next three years at a 3,600 square metre purpose-built factory in West Belfast.
The venture plans to commence production of CD-Rs within the next few months, while manufacturing of DVDs is scheduled to start in 1998, the commission said in a statement.
